resources.string: Once immersive layout and its video adapter are installed, mode/zoom changes reapply the current measured video without reopening TikTok. The immersive master switch itself still requires a host restart. Unmeasured, hidden, rebound or unsupported views wait for native layout; this does not change live or photo pages.
Use the original host video-adaptation result within the immersive area; removes Toki geometry overrides without accumulating scale.
Preserve aspect ratio. Cover suitable portrait frames only when cropping stays within the existing threshold; otherwise show the complete frame.
Preserve aspect ratio and cover the measured viewport. Edges can be cropped; extra zoom and optional confirmed black-border cropping apply only in this mode.
Preserve the entire frame inside the measured viewport. Side or top/bottom space can remain; no intentional cropping.
Scale proportionally to viewport width. Tall videos may lose top/bottom edges; short videos leave vertical space.
Scale proportionally to viewport height. Wide videos may lose side edges; narrow videos leave horizontal space.
Could not save this video setting. Check the configuration connection; changes are not confirmed.
